_comment: Minimal advisor messages (§3 advisors are fictional characters; here only their titles), Phase 1 1j. Each message has a condition the campaign checks once a month, and a cooldown so it doesn't repeat every month. {placeholders} are filled in by the game.

messages.text: Nearly every bed is taken ({students} students, {beds} beds). Without a hall or boarding house, next fall's freshmen will have nowhere to live.
Our recitation rooms are nearly full ({students} students, {seats} seats). Another classroom building would let us admit more.
We have about {months} months of running costs in the bank. Careful with new construction until the land rents come in.
We had to turn away {turned_away} admitted students this fall for lack of room.
Students have worn a path across the lawn. Pave it (V) if it's where people really walk, or let the grass grow back.
Every student still boards in town. A residence hall would keep them on the Hill: Elliott Hall can be built as a Heritage Project.
